app.title: Show HN: An e-ink frame that hears birds and draws them as 1800s illustrations
app.author: arnemunthekaas
app.description: An e-ink display frame that records bird sounds and renders 1800s-style illustrations using embedded software.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and build the firmware using the provided Makefile.
Flash the firmware onto a compatible e-ink board and verify the display boots.
Record a short bird audio clip, send it to the frame, and capture the generated illustration.
Measure the time from audio input to final image rendering and compare against the documented 5‑second benchmark.
